about_the_game:
KAISA commands you! Wishlist now!

After the sun sets and the clock strikes midnight, your task begins: you must feed your master before the first light of dawn. How hard can it possibly be to survive the night?


What happens during the day?... Well, that's another story.

Gameplay:

  • Feed your master during the night.

  • Scheme & Prepare during the day.

  • Find or order mighty weapons like REGULAR chopsticks or UNIMPRESSIVE kitchen knifes to improve your combat abilities.

  • Who knew lies could be a currency.

  • Stuff your master to turn back time.

  • Beware the noise you make, for that which listens will come..

  • Not everything is as it seems.

About the Demo

Hello and welcome to Kaisa: Resurrection!

  • We’re a small, passionate two-man team working hard to bring this game to life. This early demo is just a small taste of what’s to come, though some features are still limited.

  • We’re aiming for a September release, but to bring our full vision to life, we need your support! If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist the game—and keep an eye out for our upcoming Kickstarter.

    Our Vision

  • Kaisa: Resurrection is a brutal and rewarding experience—a game that’s easy to pick up but demands real skill to master. It’s challenging, bloody, and unforgiving, but every victory is earned.

  • We love mystery and the unexpected, and weaving those elements into the game is a big part of our goal. This demo is just a small slice of what’s ahead, but we dare you to face the horrors within and try to finish it.

    A Quick Note

  • Kaisa: Resurrection is actively in development, and this is not a finished product. Features, balance, and mechanics will continue to evolve, and big changes may come and go.

  • If you encounter a bug or have feedback, we’d love to hear from you! Drop by our Discord and let us know.

content_descriptors.notes: Sort of cute Blood and graphic violence against pixel art creatures. Is it not a scary game but it is pretty brutal in some sense.
